message.content:
**Short answer:**  
`docker start` does **not** start the Docker engine itself – it only starts an existing container.  
To bring the Docker service (the “engine”) up on Windows you need to start Docker Desktop or the underlying Windows service.

---

## 1. Starting Docker Desktop (GUI)

If you have Docker Desktop installed, simply launch the application:

```powershell
& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"
```

or double‑click the Docker Desktop icon from the Start menu / desktop.

---

## 2. Starting the Docker Windows Service (CLI)

Docker Desktop runs a Windows service named `com.docker.service`.  
You can start it from PowerShell or CMD:

| Shell | Command |
|-------|---------|
| PowerShell | `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` |
| CMD | `net start com.docker.service` |
| CMD (SC) | `sc start com.docker.service` |

### Example (PowerShell)

```powershell
Start-Service -Name com.docker.service
```

### Example (CMD)

```cmd
net start com.docker.service
```

---

## 3. Starting a Container (what `docker start` actually does)

If you already have a container created and just want to start it, use:

```bash
docker start <container_name_or_id>
```

Replace `<container_name_or_id>` with the name or ID of the container you wish to start.

---

## 4. Quick “run this command” example

If you want to start the Docker service from a script or from the command line, you can use the function below (this will execute the command on your Windows machine):

```json
{
  "command": "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service"
}
```

(Use the `functions.cmd_controller_execute` tool if you want me to run it for you.)

---

### TL;DR

| What you want | Command |
|---------------|---------|
| Start Docker engine/service | `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` (PowerShell) or `net start com.docker.service` (CMD) |
| Start Docker Desktop GUI | Launch `Docker Desktop.exe` |
| Start a container | `docker start <container_name_or_id>` |

Let me know if you’d like me to run any of these commands for you!
